description: This file contains unit tests for the Telemetry module, specifically testing the Telemetry_L2test class which interacts with the Telemetry interface via COM-RPC and JSON-RPC, and mocks various dependencies. It includes tests for uploading reports, aborting reports, setting report profile status, and handling different error scenarios.

classes.name: TelemetryNotificationHandler
classes.description: Implements the ITelemetry::INotification interface to handle telemetry upload events and synchronize with test code.

classes.name: Telemetry_L2test
classes.description: Test fixture class for Telemetry module, providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing Telemetry interactions via COM-RPC and JSON-RPC.

methods.name: Telemetry_L2test::Telemetry_L2test
methods.description: Constructor initializing mocks, expectations, and creating the telemetry interface object.

methods.name: Telemetry_L2test::~Telemetry_L2test
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up and deactivating services.

methods.name: Telemetry_L2test::OnReportUpload
methods.description: Callback invoked when an upload report event occurs, signals test thread.

methods.name: Telemetry_L2test::WaitForRequestStatus
methods.description: Waits for a specific asynchronous event to be signaled within a timeout.

methods.name: Telemetry_L2test::CreateTelemetryInterfaceObjectUsingComRPCConnection
methods.description: Creates a COM-RPC connection to the Telemetry interface.
